name: Astera Labs
thesis: Connectivity silicon (retimers, Scorpio switches) inside AI racks; Q2 revenue $392M, +104% YoY, with Scorpio X set to become the largest product line in Q3. Closed Thursday at $356.42 (+0.1%), flat on a day semiconductor ETFs rose about 1.5%, then slipped roughly 2% after hours with no company news found. Fubon initiated at Buy with a $500 target; consensus target $389.95.
risks: About 9% below the consensus target after the rebound from the Sep 15 low of $251.97, so the easy part of the recovery is done. Few hyperscaler customers, Nvidia NVLink competes directly, and a Seeking Alpha note flags Amazon warrants and mix pressuring margins.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Top custom AI chip (XPU) and AI networking supplier; Q3 FY26 AI revenue $16.7B, +221% YoY, Q4 guide ~$34.8B. Closed Thursday at $343.64 (-2.2%), the weakest AI name on a day the semiconductor ETFs gained 1.5%, as the market digests the up-to-$42B convertible loan to Anthropic; +0.5% after hours. Consensus target $531.85 (+55%) is still the widest gap among the AI names.
risks: Broadcom is now supplier, lessor and lender to a customer that lost over $8B operating in 2025 on $4.6B revenue, and the stock is trading that conflict today. China's SASAC is surveying Broadcom switches in state data centres, and long yields remain near multi-year highs.
catalyst: Q4 FY2026 earnings ~2026-12-10 (est.); Anthropic IPO pricing; any SASAC guidance on switches

name: SK hynix
thesis: Holds ~58% of HBM revenue share; Q2 operating income KRW 60.5T at a 76% margin, ~8x trailing earnings. The ADR closed Thursday at $193.50 (+5.1%), catching up with Seoul's +3.2% to KRW 1,833,000 on Micron's line that memory supply stays tight through 2028; after hours -0.9%. Seoul Friday: KRW 1,839,000 (+0.3%) while the KOSPI opened down 0.15% at 6,961. 15 analysts at Buy, ADR consensus target $252 (+30%).
risks: A Solidigm listing adds an ownership layer and the stock fell on the first report; the company has made no decision. Micron fell after its own beat, so the memory trade is priced for good news near term; Bernstein cut its target on slower HBM4 pricing and CXMT is closing the gap.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-27 (est.); any Solidigm financing decision

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: On-site fuel cells for AI data centres; Q2 revenue $1.07B, +166%, 2026 guide $3.9-4.2B. Closed Thursday at $277.58 (+0.2%), +0.4% after hours, a quiet day after Wednesday's 4.9% drop. Barclays raised its target to $308 from $276; the S&P consensus target is $280.24, 1% above the price, with Morgan Stanley $310 and RBC $335.
risks: At the consensus target at ~370x earnings, with 5-11% daily swings normal; the Fremont expansion is the bull case, not yet revenue. Oracle's Jupiter force majeure stands (gas pipeline slipped to Feb 2027, fuel-cell air permit due Nov 23). Several class actions pending.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings 2026-10-27; Jupiter air-quality permit decision by 2026-11-23

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Bottleneck supplier of gas turbines and grid gear for AI power; Q2 orders $24.2B (+88% organic), backlog ~$176B. Closed Thursday at $987.45 (+3.9%), the best mover among the large caps on the list, after an analyst reiterated a bullish view; flat after hours. Fourth-quarter $0.50 dividend declared; consensus target ~$1,237 (+25%).
risks: Premium multiple on a cyclical business (GLJ Sell, $470 target) and a +3.9% day pulls the stock further from its entry zone. Tariffs cost $100-200M in 2026, offshore wind still loses money, and TVA has no construction date or cost-sharing deal for the SMR.

name: Vertiv Holdings
thesis: Power, thermal and liquid-cooling infrastructure for AI data centres; Q2 net sales $3.27B (+24%, 18% organic) at a 22.6% adjusted operating margin, 2026 guide $14.0B. Closed Thursday at $246.12 (+2.0%), snapping three soft days on no company news; +0.1% after hours. Consensus target $338.22 (+37%); Wells Fargo and BofA are both constructive.
risks: ~57x earnings prices in the guide; Q2 organic growth was 18% with acquisitions and FX doing the rest, so the second half has to accelerate. Hyperscaler capex concentration, and Schneider, Eaton and Asian OEMs compete in liquid cooling. Medium conviction until Q3 confirms the ramp.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-22 (est.); KES deal close Q4

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Q2 revenue $1.31B (+32%) at a 57% adjusted EBITDA margin. Closed Thursday at $111.15 (-1.2%), a third day of drift after the summit (AI trading agents, 24/7 equities, prediction markets); +0.3% after hours. Robinhood has now set Q3 results for Oct 27, a week earlier than the last estimate. Consensus target ~$131-133 (+18%).
risks: Perps and autonomous AI agents draw regulators; two engineers were charged Sep 15 with insider trading on crypto listings. Revenue swings with retail and crypto volumes at ~50x earnings, and investors are already questioning valuation and slowing growth.
catalyst: Robinhood Agents rollout in October; Q3 2026 earnings 2026-10-27

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: LatAm's leading e-commerce and fintech platform; Q2 revenue $10.17B (+50%), the 30th straight quarter above 30%. Closed Thursday at $1,685.12 (-2.5%), the weakest name on the list on no company news, now down about 12% since Sep 14; +0.4% after hours. Consensus target about $2,272 (+35%) as of the last check.
risks: Operating margin is 6.7%, down from 12.2%, as it spends on shipping, credit and one-hour Sao Paulo delivery. Nu is competing hard in lending, and a high-yield US backdrop drains emerging-market flows, which is what the last two weeks look like.

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Edge network that controls bot and AI-agent traffic; Q2 revenue $696M (+36%), 120% net retention. Closed Thursday at $351.00 (+1.1%), about 2% under the Sep 22 record, a day after launching Basin (an Iceberg data lake on R2 with no egress fees); +0.1% after hours. The Deutsche Telekom tie-up and a public post-quantum CA (Q1 2027) widen the enterprise story.
risks: Trades about 4% above the $337 consensus target at ~47x sales, so any growth miss will be punished. Gross margin fell 320bps to 73.1%; Basin is another product that needs years to show in revenue.

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Q2 revenue $7.8B (+48%): Shopee GMV +28%, Monee loan book +62%, 2026 adjusted EBITDA guide above $1B. Closed Thursday at $95.27 (-2.2%), a third falling day, now -26% YTD; flat after hours. Average analyst target $155 (+63%) is the widest gap on the list, but the tape has not turned and nothing is due until Nov 10, so conviction stays medium.
risks: DBS cut to Hold earlier this week and there is no catalyst for five weeks; $95 is the level to watch, with the 52-week low at $77.05. TikTok Shop and Temu in Southeast Asia, the Brazil push against MELI, Fitch flagging consumer credit risk at SeaBank Indonesia, and small insider sales.

name: BYD
thesis: Exports drive growth: September NEV sales 463,561 (+17.0% YoY), overseas 180,700, a fifth straight monthly rise on exports offsetting a weak home market. Hong Kong reopened Friday and the shares fell 2.5% to HK$73.70 (from HK$75.60 on Sep 30) in the morning session, so the market sold the sales number. At 7.8458 HKD per USD that is $9.39. Average target HK$124.17 (+68%).
risks: Domestic sales keep shrinking as Geely, Leapmotor (+59% in September) and Xpeng take share; the price war squeezes margins and first-half profit fell 20.5%. The stock is 3% above its HK$71.40 52-week low, and EU tariffs hang over the export engine that is doing all the work.

name: Keyence Corp
thesis: Machine vision and sensors for factory automation and robotics; fiscal Q1 sales JPY 346.6B (+32.8%), net income +51% to JPY 139.1B, operating margin above 50%. Tokyo Friday morning: JPY 79,890 (-1.6%) after three up days to JPY 81,200 Thursday, no company news. At 157.92 yen per dollar that is $506. Citi upgraded to Buy with a JPY 95,000 target; consensus was JPY 97,867 at the last check (+22%).
risks: The premium multiple assumes 30%+ growth. A stronger yen or slower China capex would hit both earnings and the multiple; Toyota's August numbers show Chinese and US auto demand softening.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: Sole EUV supplier; 2026 guide EUR 43-45B at 54-56% gross margin, 2027 EUV capacity essentially sold out and low-NA EUV capacity set to grow about 30% in 2027. Closed Thursday at $1,808.49 (-0.2%) on no company news, +0.2% after hours; Micron's higher capex plan is next year's lithography orders. Consensus $2,116 as of the last check (+17%).
risks: China export limits and proposed US chip tariffs. Sentiment-driven days cut both ways (-7.3% on Sep 14), and the Oct 14 bookings number has to back the rally.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Test equipment for AI and HBM chips (~70% of revenue) plus Universal Robots cobots; Q2 revenue $1.33B, more than double. Closed Thursday at $415.79 (+3.7%), the best mover on the list for a second day on Micron's higher capex plan, +0.3% after hours. The Magnum E2 memory tester shows at SEMICON West Oct 13-15. Consensus target $446.47 (+7%).
risks: The most volatile AI name on the list (-13.3% on Sep 14) at a premium multiple, now within 7% of consensus, which leaves little room. Test orders are lumpy and come from a few customers, and the memory trade is priced for good news.

name: Tesla
thesis: Car demand is falling while the valuation rests on robotaxi, storage and Optimus. Closed Thursday at $354.11 (-0.2%), +0.4% after hours, into Q3 deliveries Friday before the open (about 22:00-23:30 AEST). Consensus: company-compiled 461,974 (-7% YoY), Barron's 450-460K, another tally 463,761; range 421,758 to 482,000; storage consensus 15.9 GWh. September registrations rose across Europe. Track it, don't chase it.
risks: A print below ~440K puts the stock back under the $350 level it has been defending. Tesla lined up $30B of credit this week (nothing drawn, none planned for 2026) as 2026 capex tops $25B and analysts model about $9.8B of negative free cash flow; JPMorgan cut its target to $415.
catalyst: Q3 deliveries 2026-10-02 pre-market; Roadster demo 2026-10-15; Q3 earnings 2026-10-28
